answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 296 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is written down against the onyx challenge, the anchor audit can replay the glacier history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 2300 identities would post 933 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
